parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural signal is limited to the alias declaration shape itself rather than any shared logic or meaningful field overlap. The types `LargeNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, and `Header` are intentionally distinct widget view aliases targeting different WidgetKit size families — their coincidental structural identity as type aliases is inherent to the Swift type-alias pattern, not a sign of unintended duplication. Collapsing them would destroy the semantic distinction between Small, Medium, and Large widget entry points, which WidgetKit requires as separate conforming types. No restraint markers are present, but the domain concepts are deliberately separate.
